sample_size.quote:
Our initial sample consists of all 62,165 firm-year observations from 1983 to 2007 with the necessary

information in Compustat and CRSP to estimate the level of expected hiring using (1).

The number of observations

used to estimate (2) is reduced to 44,861 due to the availability of the various explanatory variables.
